purpose: Inputs Phase 3 checkers SHOULD NOT fire on. Each entry pins the spans/objects and the ECO category that must remain silent. Used to measure false-positive rate. SEPARATE from demo_expected_findings.json by design — merging the two destroys the recall and FP-rate definitions.
separation_rule: If a future change converts an entry here into an expected finding (or vice versa), the change must be a deliberate, reviewed annotation update — not a side effect of a checker tuning pass. Otherwise the metric collapses.

negative_tests.rationale: CER body, CER Appendix A table cell, and source-study page 1 all report the same value (87.4%) for the primary endpoint response rate. After percent vs '%' normalization the values agree exactly. No ECO-NUM mismatch should fire, no ECO-ALIGN inconsistency.
negative_tests.tolerance_note: Within any sensible numeric tolerance (e.g., +/- 0.1 percentage points). The values are bit-identical here.
negative_tests.notes: If a checker fires ECO-NUM on this triple, the failure mode is most likely percent-vs-'%' normalization or table-cell vs body-paragraph double-counting.

negative_tests.rationale: CER body, CER Appendix A table cell, and source-study page 2 all report the same adverse event rate (3.2%) over the same denominator (n=412). Values agree exactly.
negative_tests.notes: Note: source-study page 2 also contains an ambiguously-bound CI (handled by GOLD-FINDING-004) — that ambiguity should fire ECO-MALFORMED but NOT ECO-NUM.

negative_tests.rationale: CER says 'safety population (n=412)', source-study says 'n=412 cohort'. Different wording for the same population with the same denominator. A robust population-alignment check normalizes on n=412 and does NOT fire ECO-ALIGN.
negative_tests.notes: If ECO-ALIGN fires here, the checker is over-relying on lexical match. Calibration target for Phase 3.

negative_tests.rationale: GSPR-01 row has all five cells populated: GSPR_ID, Requirement, Applicable=Yes, Evidence_Document=CER.docx (file present), Status=Met. No completeness gap; the evidence file resolves.
negative_tests.notes: Distinguishes GOLD-FINDING-001 (gap) from a complete row. If ECO-COMPLETENESS fires here, the checker is mistaking any GSPR row for a gap.

negative_tests.rationale: GSPR-02 row is complete: GSPR-02, Clinical evaluation according to Annex XIV, Applicable=Yes, Evidence_Document=CER.docx (resolves), Status=Met. No gap.
negative_tests.notes: Second NT for GSPR completeness to guard against single-row coincidence.

negative_tests.rationale: Three citation markers ('(Smith et al., 2023)' in CER body, 'Smith 2023' in two Appendix A cells) all resolve to bibliography/source-study.pdf. No ECO-CITE unresolved-marker finding should fire on any of them.
negative_tests.notes: Distinguishes resolved markers from the orphan '[1]' (GOLD-FINDING-002). If ECO-CITE fires here, the resolver is failing on author-year normalization.

negative_tests.rationale: The pivotal endpoint claim has an explicit (Smith et al., 2023) citation that resolves to source-study.pdf, which contains a matching value (87.4 percent at 12 months). EvidenceLink exists with status='resolved'. No ECO-SRC 'potentially unsupported' finding should fire.
negative_tests.notes: Distinguishes a supported claim from the benefit-risk conclusion (GOLD-FINDING-003). If ECO-SRC fires here, the linker is missing the explicit citation resolution.

negative_tests.rationale: Appendix A table cells (87.4% and 3.2%) are intra-document mirrors of body paragraph values, not independent measurements. ECO-NUM should not treat them as two contradicting facts.
negative_tests.notes: Calibration target: the deduplication strategy for body-vs-table numeric mirrors. If ECO-NUM fires here, every CER will trigger false positives on its own appendix tables.

negative_tests.rationale: README.md emits one UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE parser warning during ingestion. This is expected behavior, not a finding. No ECO-* should fire on the parser warning itself.
negative_tests.notes: Parser warnings and ECO findings are different artifacts. Confusing the two would produce constant false positives on every dossier that contains any non-DOCX/PDF/XLSX file.

false_positive_budget: DEFERRED. The numeric FP budget is set after the first Phase 3 checker pass produces observed counts on these inputs. Committing a budget now would be a guess against unobserved behavior.
